cases.scenario: Image, icon, CAPTCHA, diagram or control has no equivalent non-text alternative or a misleading one
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect accessibility tree and screen reader output for functional and informative images, then verify decorative images are ignored
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Prerecorded synchronized video speech or meaningful sound is inaccessible to deaf users
cases.expected_discriminator: Review timing, completeness, names, sound effects and readability with captions enabled
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Important visual action in prerecorded synchronized media is missing from spoken information
cases.expected_discriminator: Compare narrative, diagrams, gestures and on-screen text to spoken descriptions or complete alternative
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Prerecorded video contains visually conveyed information not available through audio
cases.expected_discriminator: Test the described track against actual visual information and verify playback selection
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Visual headings, labels, tables, lists and groups disappear or become misleading in semantic structure
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect semantic tree and linearized content with screen reader; verify headers and group labels
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: DOM or screen reader order differs from essential visual sequence
cases.expected_discriminator: Navigate linearized reading and reading order at desktop and mobile widths
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: User-personal-information fields lack machine-readable purpose despite known autocomplete tokens
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect computed autocomplete token and confirm autofill semantics for personal data
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Error, selection, link or chart series is identified only by hue
cases.expected_discriminator: Review grayscale or forced-color mode and check meaning remains available
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Readable foreground text has insufficient contrast with background
cases.expected_discriminator: Measure rendered colors across interaction states and themes, then manually inspect overlays and imagery
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Zoom or narrow view forces two-dimensional page scrolling to read standard content
cases.expected_discriminator: At 320 CSS px wide for vertical content and 256 CSS px high for horizontal content verify no information or function loss
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: State indicators, input boundaries or essential chart marks blend into adjacent colors
cases.expected_discriminator: Measure required visual indicators in all states and inspect meaningful graphic parts
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Content clips or buttons break when users override spacing
cases.expected_discriminator: Inject all four overrides simultaneously and inspect fields, dialogs, navigation and content
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Tooltips or popovers vanish before they can be read, obscure content or cannot dismiss
cases.expected_discriminator: Hover/focus, move pointer into popup, press Escape and verify timing and dismissal behavior
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Feature works only via pointer, drag or gesture when keyboard equivalent is possible
cases.expected_discriminator: Complete every function with keyboard only including menus, uploads and overlays
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Keyboard focus enters widget but cannot leave using ordinary keyboard action
cases.expected_discriminator: Keyboard through all components and confirm focus can exit; test overlays and embedded content
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Unmodified letter, number or punctuation shortcuts trigger during speech input or typing
cases.expected_discriminator: Test shortcuts with focus in input fields and with voice dictation-like single characters
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Session or form expires without allowed time adjustment or exception
cases.expected_discriminator: Reproduce timer expiry; verify exact exception or turn-off, adjustable, extend path
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Session expiry discards entered content after login renewal
cases.expected_discriminator: Let session expire mid-task, authenticate again and confirm previous task can continue
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Flash effects exceed safe threshold and risk photosensitive reactions
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect video and animations with suitable flashing analysis and specialist review
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Nonessential interaction-triggered motion causes discomfort with no disable option
cases.expected_discriminator: Set prefers-reduced-motion and trigger every motion-capable interaction
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Repeated navigation must be traversed on every page before main content
cases.expected_discriminator: Keyboard Tab from page start and verify activation lands at meaningful main region
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Browser tab title is blank, generic or misleading
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect title across routes and client-side navigation including errors
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Focus sequence breaks intended meaning or operation after modal/menu/layout changes
cases.expected_discriminator: Tab/Shift+Tab through dialogs, cards and responsive layouts in both directions
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: There is no second means to locate a page within a set of pages
cases.expected_discriminator: Find representative pages through at least two mechanisms
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Keyboard focus exists but has no visible indication
cases.expected_discriminator: Tab through all interactive elements and confirm current focus indicator is perceivable
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Pinch, multi-finger or path-based drag is the only way to operate a feature
cases.expected_discriminator: Perform all gesture-requiring actions with a single click/tap sequence
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Touch down or mouse down causes irreversible action too early
cases.expected_discriminator: Press and move pointer away before release; ensure activation is canceled or undoable
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Accessible name differs from visible button label, breaking voice activation
cases.expected_discriminator: Compare visible labels to computed accessible names for controls and voice commands
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Small touch target is difficult to activate
cases.expected_discriminator: Measure rendered target boxes on touch viewport and evaluate adjacent controls
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Screen reader pronounces all page content using wrong language
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect lang and use assistive technology to listen to representative text
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Foreign-language passage is spoken with wrong pronunciation rules
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect language changes and listen with supported screen reader and voice
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Focusing a control unexpectedly navigates or changes context
cases.expected_discriminator: Tab through controls without activation and monitor route, focus and context
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Changing selection automatically submits, navigates or moves focus without warning
cases.expected_discriminator: Change all form values and verify no unannounced context-changing side effect
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Form marks fields red but does not identify errors in text
cases.expected_discriminator: Submit invalid data, inspect messages and screen reader announcements
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Users do not know what information to enter or what format is required
cases.expected_discriminator: Review empty form and error states with keyboard and assistive technology
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: System reports invalid input but no correction advice where one is known
cases.expected_discriminator: Enter foreseeable errors and inspect repair guidance in text and assistive technology
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Irreversible high-stakes submission lacks review, correction or reversal route
cases.expected_discriminator: Run legal, financial, stored-data and test-answer submissions; verify one permitted safeguard
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: HTML contains duplicate IDs or invalid nesting but actual user-facing impact is unclear
cases.expected_discriminator: Run markup checks for quality and assess real accessibility impact under 1.3.1 or 4.1.2
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Custom control lacks accessible name, correct role or exposed state and value
cases.expected_discriminator: Inspect accessibility API tree; operate custom widget via keyboard and screen reader
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: Async validation, search results or success updates are invisible to assistive technology unless focus moves
cases.expected_discriminator: Trigger async state changes while focus stays in place and confirm screen reader announcements
cases.notes: Scenario is indicative; a reviewer must still establish context, exceptions and evidence.

cases.scenario: A validator finds a duplicate ID in a modern HTML document, but accessibility tree, labels and relations have no demonstrated harm.
cases.expected_discriminator: Do not report 4.1.1 as failed solely from HTML parsing issue; check actual semantic harm under another SC
cases.notes: W3C 2025 recommendation: considered always satisfied for HTML/XML.

cases.scenario: A synchronized training video has accurate transcript but no audio description track of important onscreen diagrams.
cases.expected_discriminator: Verify an appropriate described track; transcript alone is not equivalent at AA
cases.notes: Keep separate from captions.

cases.scenario: A fixed-width dashboard overflows horizontally at 320 CSS pixels though its text can enlarge 200%.
cases.expected_discriminator: Test standard content at equivalent 320px width and ensure only essential 2D parts scroll locally
cases.notes: 1.4.4 pass does not imply 1.4.10 pass.

cases.scenario: Button visibly says Save changes, but accessible name says Commit and screen reader says button correctly.
cases.expected_discriminator: Compare visible label words to computed name, not role alone
cases.notes: Potential failure despite 4.1.2 name presence.

cases.scenario: WCAG 2.1 AAA audit reports 25 by 25 pixel inline text link as noncompliant target.
cases.expected_discriminator: Confirm whether inline link exception applies before finding failure
cases.notes: Do not substitute 2.2 AA rule.

cases.scenario: Red and green status chips achieve 7:1 contrast but lack any text or shape difference.
cases.expected_discriminator: Check whether meaning survives monochrome rendering
cases.notes: Text contrast does not solve color-only meaning.

cases.scenario: Keyboard focus moves to a control completely covered by an author-created sticky header, banner, modal layer or footer.
cases.expected_discriminator: Tab and Shift+Tab through every control with sticky bars, drawers, validation and responsive states; confirm at least part of each focused component is visible.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: A focused field or button is partially cut off by an author-created overlay or sticky element.
cases.expected_discriminator: Keyboard-traverse all elements with overlays, sticky headers, footers and error banners active; confirm the whole component remains visible.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: The keyboard focus indicator is so thin or subtle that the active control cannot be distinguished.
cases.expected_discriminator: Compare focused/unfocused rendering using pixel samples and measure indicator area; test at zoom, browser themes and high-contrast settings.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: Reordering cards, moving a slider or drawing a route requires a continuous pointer drag without a simple alternative.
cases.expected_discriminator: With touch or mouse, complete the full drag action using discrete presses or clicks without sustained dragging; verify keyboard operation independently.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: Small icon buttons or densely packed links cause missed activation for users with tremor or limited dexterity.
cases.expected_discriminator: Measure actual clickable geometry and spacing at tested zoom and responsive breakpoints; exercise tight controls via touch and pointer.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: Help chat, contact details or support links change relative order between pages in a multi-page process.
cases.expected_discriminator: Visit every in-scope page in the process and compare relative order of recurring help controls in DOM/focus/navigation sequence.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: A checkout or onboarding flow forces users to retype previously entered data in the same process.
cases.expected_discriminator: Complete a multi-step flow with known data; confirm repeat fields are populated or selectable rather than require recollection or typing.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: Login or 2FA blocks users behind a memory, transcription or puzzle task without a suitable alternative.
cases.expected_discriminator: Verify password-manager/autofill and paste work, evaluate every sign-in/reset/recovery/MFA path, and independently test allowed alternatives with relevant users/assistive technologies.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.

cases.scenario: An authentication method still requires object recognition or identifying personal content as a cognitive hurdle.
cases.expected_discriminator: End-to-end test sign-in, recovery and second factor without cognitive-memory or object-recognition requirements; verify the assistance path works across devices.
cases.notes: New criterion in WCAG 2.2 only; validate version, level and exceptions.
